verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an employee-facing portal showing grants, vesting progress, strike price, or exit-value scenarios. What it does show is adjacent: email vesting alerts sent to holders, admin-side stakeholder profiles, company-level fundraising and exit modeling, and an unexplained 'interactive offer letters' pricing line, none of which is the employee portal the story describes.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes
